population: Reassigned source in a TESS cutout centred on a spectroscopic target
period_status: Two unequal minima per photometric repeat; orbital interpretation probable
claim_basis: previously catalogued variable with a new eclipse interpretation
prior_evidence: Gaia DR3 variability class S and AAVSO VSX type S, plus the ATLAS dubious-variable record J141.0252-22.1165 at 0.767802 d.
interpretation: TESS and resolved ZTF g and r photometry identify the same star and two unequal minima. Their broad, smooth shape also permits rotational or ellipsoidal modulation. The available data support a probable eclipsing interpretation.
